title: Meteorites and Adventure
description: Jack from the Adventurers' Guild seems to have some ideas on what to do about those fallen meteorites...

mainQuestExcel.title: Meteorites and Adventure
mainQuestExcel.description: Jack from the Adventurers' Guild seems to have some ideas on what to do about those fallen meteorites...

dialogs.text: *sigh* If only I could go check it out...
What's up?
Ah, it's you. Well, it's not like anything special happened...
Hmm. No, I suppose this is actually quite special...
You mean the meteorites?
Yes! You must have seen them too, right? They've been falling from the sky for a while now.
Thanks to the Anemo God's protection... or maybe just blind good luck, none of them have hit the city so far.
But quite a few have landed outside the city, and they say that whoever touches one of those meteorites will fall into a deep sleep... a kind of slumber that no one can wake them up from.
Cyrus has already gathered and commissioned quite a few adventurers. Some were sent to inform those still out there in the wild to seek shelter in the city...
The others were to help the Knights of Favonius ascertain the positions of the fallen meteorites...
And perform search and rescue operations around those meteorites.
As for me, Cyrus said that I'd best stay in the city and help to take care of those who've fallen unconscious.
Maybe it's because my skills aren't up to par yet... But if I'm always stuck with these small tasks, I'll never get the chance to become stronger.
*sigh* Regardless, I have to do what I've been assigned to do, and do it well... Still, can I ask you for a favor, Traveler?
I'd like you to help me go out there and gather some information regarding those meteorites...
What would you need information for?
Cyrus always says that you should be fully prepared before starting any adventure.
If I could persuade him that I understand the situation well enough, and that I've made the necessary preparations...
Maybe he might let me join the investigation teams.
But I'm busy helping people here at the moment, so I can't go out to gather any information.
So, please, Traveler! Help me go outside and investigate the situation. You don't have to go far, just the Whispering Woods will do.
If you find anything, come back and tell me. Whether I can go out and investigate or not... it's all in your hands now!
So you want to sneak out and...
What? Sneak out and... No! Not at all!
I do want to go out and investigate, yes... But help is needed inside the city, too, and that's very important! I can't just drop my duties like that...
But it's just that... Well, Cyrus always says that you should make full preparations before starting any adventure.
If I could persuade him that I understand the situation well enough, and that I've made the necessary preparations...
Maybe he might let me join the investigation teams.
But I'm busy helping people here at the moment, so I can't go out to gather any information.
You mean the half-price anniversary promotion at Good Hunter?
What!? The Good Hunter's having a promotion today? How did I not hear about that?
Uh, no, wait! That's not what I wanted to talk about...
So, meteorites have been raining down from the sky lately. I'm sure you've seen them too.
Thanks to the Anemo God's protection... or maybe just blind good luck, none of them have hit the city so far.
*sigh* I wonder if I'll be able to convince Cyrus...
Why do you want to join the outdoor investigation?
Well, um... I mean, you have to take part in important jobs to prove your worth, you know? That's what I think, at least...
But if you mess up...
Hey! I haven't done anything yet! Don't jinx me!
*sigh* I wonder if I'll be able to convince Cyrus...
Why do you want to join the outdoor investigation?
Well, um... I mean, you have to take part in important jobs to prove your worth, you know? That's what I think, at least...
But if you mess up...
Hey! I haven't done anything yet! Don't jinx me!
Well, looks like I've shaken them off for now. Still, what on earth is going on here...
Did you come to investigate the meteorites?
Yes, I did. Took a commission from the Guild and all to investigate matters related to the meteorites.
But monsters near the spots where meteorites have landed have starting acting up all of a sudden.
Their strength, movements, and a whole host of other things are totally abnormal, and there's more of them than you usually see, as well.
I was discovered, and didn't dare stay in the area, and so I took a few lesser-tread paths to shake them off my trail.
I have to report these abnormalities to Cyrus as soon as possible.
Is there anything else of note?
Anything else? Well, if I had to say it, it's that quite a few scholars are refusing to return to the city.
No matter how hard I tried to convince them, they insisted on continuing their research.
There aren't enough of us adventurers out here either, so we can't simply send them reminders every few days...
This is such a headache...
Well, Traveler, if there's nothing else, you should be seeking shelter in the city too. We haven't the time to be dallying out here.

You're back. Did you discover anything?
There aren't a lot of adventurers out there investigating...
Ugh. Now that you mention it, there weren't a lot of adventurers who took up this set of commissions...
It's always the same few people coming and going. Cyrus has been quite concerned, as well.
There are still some scholars who refuse to seek shelter in the city.
Is that so... Well, they've never been the easiest to convince.
The monsters seem to be somewhat abnormal.
Abnormal? Perhaps it's the influence of the meteorites, then... Still, I suspect that someone has reported this already.
Besides, I have trouble taking on normal monsters. As for these abnormal ones... the less said the better.
Alright, I understand the situation now. Please take these as thanks for helping me investigate.
Scholars who refuse to seek shelter, abnormal monsters, and a lack of available manpower...
Come on, Jack, think... There has to be some way to convince Cyrus...
